title: We Bring the Boom
blurb: An announcement rather than a warning, and the distinction matters. Whatever is about to happen has already been decided, the paperwork is filed, and you are simply being informed as a courtesy. That total absence of doubt is what makes the clip so useful for edits: it front-loads the confidence so the footage does not have to earn it. Play it before entrances, plot twists, and any moment where the energy in a room is about to change permanently. Nobody who says this sentence has ever been talked out of anything.
